literacy_pct.note: Census 2011 (latest census); compiled for the 33-district geography.

infant_mortality.reason: NFHS-5 district key-indicator factsheets do not report mortality indicators (no IMR/NNMR/U5MR at district level); IMR published at state/national level only.

dropout_rate_secondary.reason: No district-wise secondary dropout published for Telangana: UDISE+ releases district figures only via the JS-based dashboard (udiseplus.gov.in); parliamentary annexures found give state-wise figures only (e.g. Lok Sabha USQ 192 answered 21.07.2025, Annexure-I, state-wise 2021-22 to 2023-24). The district-wise annexure located (Lok Sabha USQ 1788 answered 10.03.2025) covers Andhra Pradesh only.

pupil_teacher_ratio_primary.reason: No district-wise primary PTR published: UDISE+ releases PTR only at national/state level; district report cards are generated on-demand via the JS-based UDISE+ dashboard (udiseplus.gov.in), unreadable via text fetch.

sdg_index_score.reason: NITI Aayog has not published district-level SDG Index scores for Telangana districts. NITI's district-level SDG indices cover only the North-Eastern Region states and selected other states; the SDG India Index for Telangana is state-level only.

mgnrega_persondays_fy25.note: Part-year figure: persondays generated as on 24 January 2025 (Fig 13.1, in lakh, converted to absolute).

pmayg_houses_completed.reason: Telangana did not implement PMAY-G since the scheme's inception on 01.04.2016 (Lok Sabha USQ 1355 answered 11.02.2025; Lok Sabha Starred Q 245). The state runs its own Indiramma housing scheme; linkage of Indiramma houses with PMAY-G began only in October 2026.

jjm_tap_connections.reason: District-wise cumulative tap connections are published only on the JS-driven JJM-IMIS dashboard (ejalshakti.gov.in); no static district-wise source found. State-level: Telangana has declared 100% Har Ghar Jal (tap connections to all rural households).

per_capita_income_inr.note: Fig 2.7, Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Government of Telangana.

crime_rate_per_lakh.reason: NCRB 'Crime in India' district data reports police jurisdictions, not Telangana's 33 revenue districts (e.g. Hyderabad city is split across three police commissionerates; the Warangal unit covers two revenue districts; five revenue districts have no corresponding unit), so per-lakh rates by revenue district would misattribute crime. Not computed rather than miscomputed.

crimes_against_women_per_lakh.reason: Same police-jurisdiction vs revenue-district mismatch as crime_rate_per_lakh: NCRB district rows do not map to Telangana's 33 revenue districts, so a per-lakh rate would misattribute crimes against women.
